_readme: Edit this file to add a release, then run: python3 build_music.py  (it rewrites the release grid + lyrics in music.html). Releases display in the order listed unless newest_first is true.

releases.title: Hard Times
releases.lyrics:
Hard times hit the ones who care the most,
The quiet ones who give until they're ghosts.
You hold the weight while others walk away,
Hard times don't care who's kind — they come to stay.

You learn real quick when no one's holding on,
You feel the cold when everyone is gone.
They take your heart, your hope, your second try,
Hard times — they find the good and drain them dry.

Hard times — they come for those who feel,
Hard times — they break what's real.
Hard times — they don't forgive,
They take the ones who still believe and give.

You built them up, you stayed when it got rough,
You gave your all but it was never enough.
They wanted more, they wanted what you bled,
Hard times took what you had and left you for dead.

But here's the truth they never want you to see,
Hard times don't mean you're weak — they mean you're free.
Free from the weight of carrying the ones who won't,
Free from the ones who take but never show they don't.

Hard times — they come for those who fight,
Hard times — they steal your light.
Hard times — they leave you raw,
But you're still standing when they're gone for sure.

Yeah, you gave your best to people who couldn't care,
You showed up when they vanished in the air.
But don't forget — you carried what they dropped,
Hard times came but you never stopped.

You never stopped loving, you never stopped trying,
You never stopped even when you were dying inside.
Hard times showed you who would stay and who would leave,
Hard times taught you the truth of what you believe.

Hard times — they come for those who feel,
Hard times — they shatter what's real.
Hard times — they leave their mark,
But you're the one still holding light inside the dark.

Don't lose that fire, don't lose your fight,
Hard times don't get to steal your light.
You're stronger now, you know the cost,
Hard times came — but you're not lost.

Cause here's the truth when it all falls apart,
Hard times only break a fragile heart.
But yours kept beating when it should've quit,
Hard times came but you're still in it.

They'll tell you to forgive, to let it slide,
To be the bigger person, swallow pride.
But let me tell you something they don't say,
Not everyone deserves your love that way.

Some people drain you, some people take,
Some leave you hollow for their own sake.
Balance ain't weakness, truth ain't war,
We all need love — that's what it's for.

So next time you win, next time you shine,
Remember the hands that held the line.
'Cause hard times, yeah they always find,
Every heart that's left behind

releases.title: Wake Up
releases.lyrics:
They say you gotta pray, keep your head held high,
But the world just breaks you down when you're barely getting by.
They want you docile, soft, broken down inside,
While they stack the chips against you and decide which rules apply.

Oh they want your silence, they want you tired and small,
Chasing empty comforts while they're standing tall.
But what if waking up means calling out the game?
What if breaking through means learning how to claim—

Wake up—
This is not the way it has to be.
Wake up—
You don't have to smile and agree.
Wake up—
There's fire in you if you just believe,
Wake up — you're stronger than the life they need you to lead.

Ambition isn't selfish, anger has its place,
Not every gentle word deserves to win the race.
They tell you healing means you swallow what they deal,
But sometimes breaking free's the only way to feel real.

Don't confuse the peace they want with peace you choose,
Don't stay small and kind if all you do is lose.
What if waking up means standing in the storm?
What if breaking through means taking back your form?

Wake up—
This is not the way it has to be.
Wake up—
You don't have to smile and agree.
Wake up—
There's fire in you if you just believe,
Wake up — you're stronger than the life they need you to lead.

Yeah they tell you healing, growth, self-work, and light,
But some of that's designed to keep you from the fight.
Not all forgiveness frees, not all anger kills,
Sometimes waking up is learning when to feel—

Wake up—
You're sharper than they want you to know.
Wake up—
Don't stay stuck in that comfortable low.
Wake up—
There's more to this if you just let it show,
Wake up — there's strength in you they don't want you to grow.

Wake up — don't let them tell you who to be.
Wake up — reclaim your right to clarity.
Wake up — the game is rigged but you can see,
Wake up — you're stronger than the life they want you to lead.

releases.title: who am i
releases.lyrics:
Who am I if I'm not who I was before?
Not the name, not the face I've been holding to the floor.
They want an answer clean, something I can prove,
But I'm caught between the past and the next move.

Tell me who I am when the mirror doesn't speak,
When the ground beneath my feet feels too weak.
Is it the battles that I've lost, the wars I didn't win?
Or the quiet way I kept trying to begin again?

Who am I — if I strip it all away?
Who am I — when there's nothing left to say?
Who am I — if I'm no longer chasing pain,
Who am I without the weight of my own name?

I've been told that change is growth, that letting go is free,
But what if all I've known is falling endlessly?
They say find yourself — like it's buried in the sand,
But what if I'm just learning how to stand?

Tell me who I am when I'm tired of the roles,
When I can't keep playing parts to fill the holes.
Is it the person I became when nobody could see?
Or the version I've been running from that's calling out to me?

Who am I — if I strip it all away?
Who am I — when there's nothing left to say?
Who am I — if I'm no longer chasing pain,
Who am I without the weight of my own name?

Maybe I'm the question more than I'm the answer found,
Maybe I'm the silence when there's too much sound.
Maybe I'm the fracture and the way it holds,
Maybe I'm the story that's still being told.

Who am I — if I'm more than what I've been?
Who am I — if I let the light back in?
Who am I — if I choose to start again,
Who am I if I release the need to win?

Who am I — standing here without disguise?
Who am I — if I look behind the lies?
Who am I — if I'm learning to forgive,
Who am I if I finally choose to live?
